تناقصت (form VI)

# تَنَاقَصْتَ (tanāqaṣta) /ta.naː.qasˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاقَصَ (tanāqaṣa)
# تَنَاقَصْتِ (tanāqaṣti) /ta.naː.qasˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاقَصَ (tanāqaṣa)
# تَنَاقَصَتْ (tanāqaṣat) /ta.naː.qa.sˤat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
